note: 素材来自今天的 X 简报和持仓表，仅供语言练习，不构成投资建议

listen.title: Today in Tech and Markets
listen.text: Anthropic's IPO filing is the talk of X today. The company reported revenue of 16.3 billion dollars in the first half of 2026, up from 1.1 billion a year earlier. However, it also posted a net loss of 80.7 billion dollars, mainly due to accounting charges related to fundraising. In China-related news, ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have reportedly ordered more than three million compliant Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 inference cards, worth over 35 billion dollars at list price. But Nvidia says buyers may receive only five to ten percent of that amount. Meanwhile, at SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call, Elon Musk said the company will deploy about 200,000 GB300 GPUs a month for the rest of the year. On Wall Street, Netflix met revenue expectations but gave weaker guidance, and its shares fell five to six percent after hours. Finally, Citadel's Ken Griffin said the market is "almost certainly" in an AI bubble.

questions.q: What was Anthropic's revenue in the first half of 2026?
questions.a: 16.3 billion dollars (up from 1.1 billion a year earlier).

questions.q: What share of the ordered Nvidia cards might Chinese buyers actually receive?
Why did Netflix shares fall after hours?
questions.a: Revenue met expectations, but its guidance was weaker than expected.

zh: Anthropic 的 IPO 申报是今天 X 上的热门话题。
公司 2026 年上半年营收 163 亿美元，上年同期为 11 亿美元。
但它也录得 807 亿美元净亏损，主要来自与融资相关的会计费用。
中国相关新闻：据报道字节、阿里和腾讯订购了超过 300 万张合规版英伟达 RTX PRO 5500 推理卡，按标价超过 350 亿美元。
但英伟达称买家可能只能拿到其中 5% 到 10%。
另外，在 SpaceX 第三季度财报电话会上，马斯克称公司今年余下时间每月将部署约 20 万块 GB300 GPU。
华尔街方面，奈飞营收符合预期但指引偏弱，盘后跌 5% 到 6%。
最后，Citadel 的 Ken Griffin 称市场“几乎肯定”处于 AI 泡沫中。

speak.prompt:
You are my English speaking coach. Let's do a role-play. You are a cautious equity analyst; I am an investor who holds Tencent (0700.HK), Alibaba (BABA) and Zhipu (2513.HK).
Facts we can use (do not invent others):
- Tencent: bought at HK$451.6 on Sept 22, now HK$393.8; it is about 24.7% of my portfolio.
- Alibaba: bought at US$116.31, now about US$104.32.
- Zhipu: bought at HK$742, now HK$496.
- ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent reportedly ordered 3M+ Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 inference cards (35B+ USD at list price), but Nvidia says buyers may get only 5–10%.
- Ken Griffin says the market is "almost certainly" in an AI bubble.
Rules:
1. Speak at B1–B2 level, short turns, ask me one question at a time.
2. After every 3 of my sentences, pause and give feedback: (a) grammar mistakes, (b) pronunciation issues you can infer, (c) one more natural way to say what I said.
3. Don't rewrite everything — max 3 corrections each time.
4. After 10 minutes, summarize my top 5 mistakes and give me 5 useful phrases.
Start by asking me why I still hold Tencent.
questions: Should an investor worry if a stock falls about 13% in one month, like Tencent? Why or why not?
Do you agree with Ken Griffin that the market is in an AI bubble? Give one reason.
If Chinese companies only get 5–10% of the Nvidia chips they ordered, what could that mean for them?
speak.zh: 口语角色扮演：你是谨慎的股票分析师，我是持有腾讯、阿里、智谱的投资者；只用给定事实。

read.title: AI Agents, Hotels and Chips
read.text: The online travel industry is watching AI closely. Sam Shank, co-founder of HotelTonight, believes AI agents could disrupt the paid-ranking model that big online travel agencies rely on. He plans to position HotelTonight as a specialist agent for last-minute stays. Meanwhile, Agoda says its supply of luxury hotels has doubled in four years, and searches for five-star hotels in Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok and Bali are rising. Still, Skift points out that it is hard to prove Agoda can sell luxury until it shares booking data. Airbnb is also changing its rules. For bookings after November 20, hosts can only make "reasonable" checkout requests, such as putting dishes in the sink. Guests welcomed the change, but some hosts said they would remove their listings. In hardware, Super Micro raised its quarterly revenue forecast from 14.5–15.5 billion dollars to 18.5–19.5 billion dollars, and its shares jumped after hours.
vocab: AI agents could disrupt the paid-ranking model of big OTAs.
Shank wants to position HotelTonight as a last-minute specialist.
Agoda says its supply of luxury hotels has doubled.
Some Airbnb hosts said they would remove their listings.
Super Micro raised its revenue forecast for the quarter.

questions.q: According to Sam Shank, what could AI agents threaten?
questions.a: The paid-ranking model that big OTAs rely on.

questions.q: Why does Skift doubt Agoda's luxury strategy?
questions.a: Agoda hasn't shared booking data, so it's hard to prove it can sell luxury.

questions.q: Give one example of a "reasonable" checkout request.

zh: 在线旅游行业正密切关注 AI。
HotelTonight 联合创始人 Sam Shank 认为，AI 智能体可能颠覆大型 OTA 依赖的付费排名模式。
他计划把 HotelTonight 定位为专做临时入住的专业智能体。
同时 Agoda 称其豪华酒店供给四年翻倍，吉隆坡、曼谷和巴厘岛的五星酒店搜索量在上升。
不过 Skift 指出，在 Agoda 公布预订数据之前，很难证明它能卖好豪华酒店。
11 月 20 日之后的预订，房东只能提出“合理”的退房要求，比如把碗碟放进水槽。
房客欢迎这一变化，但部分房东说会下架房源。
硬件方面，超微把季度营收预期从 145–155 亿美元上调到 185–195 亿美元，盘后股价大涨。

write.task:
选一只持仓（推荐智谱或美团），用英语写 5–8 句点评。只用这些数字：
Zhipu (2513.HK)：HK$742（9/22）→ HK$496，约 -33%，占组合 7.8%
Meituan (3690.HK)：HK$73.2 → HK$74.7，约 +2%，占组合 10.7%
结构：1 句现状 → 2 句数字 → 2 句看法/风险 → 1–2 句下一步。
phrases: Since September 22, the stock has fallen/risen by about __%.
It now makes up __% of my portfolio.
One reason I'm still holding it is that ...
I plan to keep an eye on ...
It's too early to say whether ...
write.feedbackPrompt: Don't rewrite my text. List my 5 most important mistakes and explain why, then give one more natural version of my weakest sentence.
write.model: Meituan has been the most stable stock in my portfolio this month. Since September 22, it has risen from HK$73.2 to HK$74.7, a gain of about 2%. It now makes up 10.7% of my portfolio. One reason I'm still holding it is that it has held up better than Tencent and Alibaba. On the other hand, a small gain doesn't guarantee future growth. I plan to keep an eye on it rather than add more right now.
write.check: 自查：现在完成时（has fallen since…）、百分比（by about 33%）、make up X% of
write.zh: 选一只持仓写 5–8 句英文点评，只用给定数字：现状 → 数字 → 看法/风险 → 下一步。
